Daily Devotional

October 16

25 Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. Is not the life more than meat, and the body than raiment? (Matthew 6:25 KJV)

Jesus had been teaching on not laying up treasures on earth, but to lay up our treasures in Heaven, as where your treasures are is where your heart will be (Matthew 6:19-20). This is telling us to not be focused on the things of this world, but instead to put first the Kingdom of God and all these things will be added to us (Matthew 6:33). We, of course, live in this world, and must do certain things to be able to exist, but we should always put first the Kingdom of God, and not spend all our time on worldly matters. The devil doesn’t need to get us to worshiping him, only to be so busy with things of the world, that we don’t have time for God. How many of us stay so busy with our daily lives, that we don’t have time to keep our minds on the Lord?

This is such a true revelation, as when you are constantly worrying about the things of this life, you tend to quit having time for God. We Christians need to always place our cares upon the Lord (Matthew 11:28-30), and not worry with meeting all the daily needs, as He will see that they are provided, if we will just put our faith in Him, and trust Him to meet the needs of this life. Preoccupation with worldly things is what the devil loves to see us do, as that takes us away from living for God. The devil will always try and get you concerned about making money, getting things, and providing for all your needs, when God could do it much better, if we will just trust in Him. Do you spend a lot of time, worrying about what you need and want? If so, you are serving the devil! Keep your mind on the Lord at all times.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
